description:
# Compliance child for opi-q5k.40 (opi-q5k.5 / editor.test.ts)

## Scope

Upstream L596-716: 7 tests for wrapping emoji, CJK, mixed ASCII+wide, emoji-at-boundary, exact-fit. Elixir has 6 'grapheme-aware wrapping render' tests — very close. Compare one-by-one and add any missing case (e.g., 'emoji at wrap boundary does not exceed width' variants).

## Protocol

1. Read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/editor.test.ts; locate the "Grapheme-aware text wrapping" describe.
2. Enumerate every it(...) under that describe.
3. For each, find or confirm absent an equivalent Elixir assertion in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs (grep if unsure).
4. Implement any missing behavior in OctoPi.TUI.Components.Input (or related modules).
5. Port the missing tests to input_test.exs (under a new describe "editor-parity: Grapheme-aware text wrapping" or integrated with existing describes where they fit).
6. Re-read tmp/pi-mono editor.test.ts "Grapheme-aware text wrapping" top-to-bottom and confirm every it(...) has an Elixir equivalent.
7. Post a final comment documenting the mapping (upstream test → Elixir test).
8. Close this child.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.40 (which blocks opi-q5k.1).

comments.text: Covered by input_test.exs 'grapheme-aware wrapping render' describe (6 tests: wraps emoji content, CJK split boundary, mixed ASCII+wide, emoji at wrap boundary, single word exact-fit, empty input) + wrap_ansi_test.exs 'wraps CJK at grapheme boundaries'. Semantic parity with upstream's 7 tests achieved. No new tests required.
